### Enseignement, recherche et engagement

L'Université College Cork (UCC) a démontré sa détermination à intégrer la durabilité dans ses programmes et activités. Les résultats des crédits STARS suivants reflètent cette approche :

- L'université obtient 14 points STARS sur 14 au crédit AC-1, niveau maximal au crédit AC-1 Offre de cours en durabilité, niveau maximal.
- L'université obtient 14,69 points STARS sur 15 au crédit AC-2, niveau élevé au crédit AC-2 Programmes de premier cycle, niveau élevé.
- L'université obtient 7,09 points STARS sur 8 au crédit AC-3, niveau élevé au crédit AC-3 Programmes de cycles supérieurs, niveau élevé.
- L'université obtient 10 points STARS sur 10 au crédit AC-6, niveau maximal au crédit AC-6 Recherche en durabilité, niveau maximal.
- L'université obtient 6 points STARS sur 6 au crédit AC-7, niveau maximal au crédit AC-7 Centre de recherche en durabilité, niveau maximal.
- L'université obtient 5 points STARS sur 5 au crédit EN-1, niveau maximal au crédit EN-1 Communication et sensibilisation, niveau maximal.
- L'université obtient 9 points STARS sur 9 au crédit EN-2, niveau maximal au crédit EN-2 Activités parascolaires, niveau maximal.
- L'université obtient 8 points STARS sur 8 au crédit EN-3, niveau maximal au crédit EN-3 Engagement et formation du personnel, niveau maximal.
- L'université obtient 7 points STARS sur 8 au crédit EN-5, niveau élevé au crédit EN-5 Engagement civique, niveau élevé.
- L'université obtient 3 points STARS sur 3 au crédit EN-7, niveau maximal au crédit EN-7 Formation continue, niveau maximal.

### Limites et omissions

Ce rapport ne peut pas établir si les programmes et activités de l'université sont accessibles à tous les étudiants et membres du personnel.

title: Enseignement, recherche et engagement (hors GRI)

evidence.text: Support for integrating sustainability in the curriculum in UCC has taken a number of form:

The percentage of undergraduate qualifications was determined using the number of students that graduated from the programmes that were mapped as being focussed on sustainability. The high number of "qualifications awarded that are focused on subjects other than sustainability but have sustainability-focused learning requirements" is because all students graduating from Cork University Business School are required to have taken the Schools "Planet" module. “Planet - Preparing Leaders for a Sustainable World” was created to equip students with a high level of knowledge about environmental aspects of sustainability, complimenting the learning students undertake in their chosen programme of stu

The Sustainability Institute is UCC's primary institute for sustainability research. it uses a global challenge-based approach to respond to, and find research solutions for, the core environmental challenges of Climate Action, Circular Economy, and Healthy Environment. The ERI brings together over researchers (Staff & students) from different disciplines with expertise in the broad research platforms of Environment, Sustainable Energy, Marine, Sustainable Agri-Food, and Sustainable Materials.

UCC's committment to sustainability is highlighted throughout many of the key documents and communications that all staff and students would recieve on entering the University. All new student and staff orientation events and documents reference the Green Campus programme and highlight UCC's strength in sustainability. News items on Sustainability are sent to the staff and student body regulalry through the President's Quarterly message as well as the Office of Sustainability and Climate Action Newsletter which are published on the University's Workvivo site.

Aside from participation in Societies, UCC students also engage with sustainability activities through the UCC Graduate Attributes Programme, one example of this is the "Your Compass" resource - Your Compass | University College Cork, programme, which over students have actively engaged in.

UCC's Centre for Adult and Continuing Education offers the Diploma in Environment, Sustainability and Climate. The course introduces students to key theories and skills related to the environment and related sustainable and societal issues within their own organisations.
